After arguing the matter for some time, learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the Petition may be disposed of as withdrawn reserving liberty in favour of the Petitioner to seek discharge/file a discharge application before the trial court which may be directed to consider the same and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.

Petition stands disposed of as withdrawn reserving liberty in favour of the Petitioner to seek discharge/file discharge application, which shall be considered by the trial Court in accordance with law as NC: 2025:KHC:24961 HC-KAR expeditiously as possible and at any rate, within a period of three months from the date on which the Petitioner files the discharge application before the trial Court.
All rival contentions and all aspects of the matter are kept open and no opinion is expressed on the same.
